about: Long master (talking head, podcast, course video) before review or delivery: grade applied, faces inside the frame, secrets on screen. No hook or caption checks (masters carry neither); captions burned into a master: add the short pack's caption_off_face. video_ci.py widens every step on long files so a check never takes more than 150 stills.

checks.ask: The person's head is cropped by the side of the frame.
checks.yes: the frame edge cuts through the face or head, so an eye, cheek or half the face is missing
checks.no: the whole head is inside the frame, or no person is shown

checks.ask: The image has strong contrast with deep black shadows.
Private information is readable on screen: a password, Wi-Fi network key, email address, phone number, access code or API key.
